title: ConnectionsSetIntegrationMethodResult
description: Result of the connections.setIntegrationMethod JSON-RPC method: which fingerprint was answered, with which method — so the renderer's retry of the open is keyed on the identity the backend actually wrote rather than its own copy of the request. The single declaration of this shape: the renderer's TypeScript type is generated from it and the Go transport is validated against it.

hostRecordSaved.description: Whether the host record was saved. False means the answer applies only until restart.

fingerprint.description: SHA256 fingerprint of the host key the answer was recorded under.

method.description: The method as written (raw, script or helper).
